sections.text: Elemental magic is a skill related to Elemental magic weapon class.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
Higher skill level in elemental magic reduces the Eitr cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
Dundr Eitr cost is not reduced by Elemental magic Skill.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

sections.text: The player gains xp when hitting a creature with a staff. The amount is dependent on the staff used.

full_text:
Elemental magic (skill)

Description: Damage and Eitr usage when using Elemental magic.

Introduction. Elemental magic is a skill related to Elemental magic weapon class.

Effects. Higher skill level in elemental magic reduces the Eitr cost to attack down to -33% and increases damage and knockback up to +141%.
Dundr Eitr cost is not reduced by Elemental magic Skill.
For the details of damage scaling, see Damage mechanics#Skill factor.

Leveling up. The player gains xp when hitting a creature with a staff. The amount is dependent on the staff used.
